snapshot.title: Backlog: spec fidelity, architecture cleanup, and UX polish
snapshot.description: Execute prioritized improvements identified from codebase and knowns spec/doc audit: fix source-of-truth docs, reduce runtime logging noise, refactor large scripts, add onboarding/briefing UX, extend automated tests, and clean stale assets/tasks.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Spec/docs inconsistencies and broken references are resolved
Runtime logging is normalized through Logger with reduced print noise
Large script refactors are delivered with unchanged behavior
Mission onboarding and briefing UX are implemented and validated
New tests cover recently added weather/UI systems
Stale/duplicate tasks and legacy backup files are cleaned up
